description: This Java source file defines an abstract serializer class for handling JSON-based serialization of Jsonifiable objects with Ditto headers, supporting serialization and deserialization via ByteBuffer and byte arrays, with metrics and logging integration.

classes.name: AbstractJsonifiableWithDittoHeadersSerializer
classes.description: An abstract serializer class for serializing and deserializing Jsonifiable objects with Ditto headers, supporting custom mapping strategies, buffer pooling, and metrics.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Provides a string manifest for the object to aid in deserialization.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Serializes an object implementing Jsonifiable to a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: serializeIntoByteBuffer
methods.description: Abstract method to serialize a JsonObject into a ByteBuffer, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Serializes an object to a byte array.

methods.name: fromBinary
methods.description: Deserializes a ByteBuffer into a Jsonifiable object.

methods.name: fromBinary
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into a Jsonifiable object.

methods.name: tryToCreateKnownJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Attempts to create a Jsonifiable object from a ByteBuffer based on manifest.

methods.name: createJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Creates a Jsonifiable object from a ByteBuffer based on manifest and deserializes JSON payload.

methods.name: deserializeFromByteBuffer
methods.description: Abstract method to deserialize a ByteBuffer into a JsonValue, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload JsonObject from a JsonObject, defaulting to an empty object if absent.
